_about: Every optional production setting, in one place. The deploy workflow (.github/workflows/deploy-gcp.yml) wires each one that exists in Secret Manager into the Cloud Run service, and deploy/gcp/secrets-page.html (built from this file by scripts/build_secrets_page.py) is the page the operator fills in to create them. Secret id: 'secret'. A value never lives in git.

groups.title: AI marking and scan reading
groups.blurb: Reads photographed answer sheets, marks written answers and runs the doubt critic. Without it those features say they are not enabled for the school; nothing else is affected. Production accepts Sarvam only.

items.label: Sarvam API key
items.help: From dashboard.sarvam.ai, API keys. One key serves both names the code reads.
items.unlocks: Scan OCR, AI marking, doubt critic

groups.title: Composio (email and calendar actions)
groups.blurb: Composio sends email and writes to a connected Google Calendar for the apps. Optional if you use SMTP for email.

items.label: Composio API key
items.help: app.composio.dev, Settings, API keys. The full key is much longer than 23 characters.

items.label: Composio calendar user id
items.help: The Composio entity (user id) that owns the connected Google Calendar.

items.label: Composio connected account id
items.help: The connected account id of that Google Calendar, from Composio's Connected accounts.

groups.title: Email by SMTP
groups.blurb: Used for sign-in codes, password resets and notices when Composio is not set. Any provider works (Gmail with an app password, Zoho, SES, Brevo).

items.label: SMTP host
items.help: For example smtp.gmail.com

items.label: SMTP port
items.help: 587 for STARTTLS (the default).

items.label: SMTP user
items.help: Usually the full sender address.

items.label: SMTP password
items.help: An app password, not your own login password.

items.label: From address
items.help: What recipients see. Defaults to the SMTP user.

groups.title: WhatsApp notices
groups.blurb: Parents get timetable, exam and marks notices on WhatsApp through the Meta Cloud API. Needs an approved message template.

items.label: WhatsApp access token
items.help: A permanent system-user token from Meta Business, WhatsApp Cloud API.

items.label: Phone number id
items.help: Meta Business, WhatsApp, API setup: the id of the sending number (digits).

items.label: Template name
items.help: The approved template's name. Defaults to academicos_notice.

items.label: Graph API version
items.help: Defaults to v21.0.

groups.title: SMS notices
groups.blurb: A DLT-approved SMS template sent through MSG91, for parents without WhatsApp.

items.label: MSG91 auth key
items.help: MSG91 dashboard, Authkey.

items.label: DLT template id
items.help: The approved template id in MSG91.

groups.title: Sign in with Google
groups.blurb: Adds a Google button to the sign-in page. The client id is public, but it is kept here so it is set the same way as everything else.

items.label: Google OAuth client id
items.help: Google Cloud console, APIs and services, Credentials, a Web client. Authorised origin: your web address.

groups.title: Push notifications (phone apps)
groups.blurb: Firebase Cloud Messaging. The service account the backend runs as also needs the Firebase Cloud Messaging API Admin role.

items.label: Firebase project id
items.help: Firebase console, Project settings. Defaults to the Google Cloud project.

groups.title: Operator keys
groups.blurb: Ours, not a school's. Generate them here; they are shown once so you can keep a copy in your password manager.

items.label: Operations key
items.help: Lets the operator read the error list (GET /api/v1/ops/errors).

items.label: Scheduler key
items.help: The shared secret the daily scheduler job sends to run reminders and digests.

items.label: Web address in emailed links
items.help: The address invite and reset links point to. Defaults to the Firebase site.
